exchanges: cant sleep the people across the road are having a party
That's frustrating, especially on a weeknight. Is it the loud music kind or just voices?
music and shouting the usual friday thing tbh its not even friday
Ha, someone's started the weekend early. Earplugs might be your best friend tonight.
i dont have any tariq might hes got everything
Worth knocking on his door if he's still up.
hes not back yet hes at his dance class on tuesdays he does salsa at the community centre
That's a fun way to spend an evening. Has he been going long?
like 6 months hes actually decent now he showed us in the kitchen
A kitchen demo, nice. Shared houses need more of that.
lol it was chaos oliwia nearly got kicked
Dangerous dance floor. Was Oliwia a good sport about it?
yeah shes chill shes been stressed though cause her sister just moved to Gdansk for work and she misses her
That's a big distance to suddenly have between you. Video calls help, but it's not the same.
exactly and then her brothers wife moved to Bristol last month too so all her family is scattered now
That's a lot of change at once. No wonder she's feeling it.
ya i told her we should do a house dinner this weekend to cheer her up
That's thoughtful. Anything she especially likes to eat?
pierogi obviously her mum sends her a recipe
Perfect, a taste of home. Making them together could be fun too.
erol from the kebab shop said hed lend us his big pot
Nice of him. Sounds like you've got a good relationship with the local shops.
erol is the best he gives us free chips and talks football at me for ages hes mad about Galatasaray
Ha, a passionate fan then. Do you follow football at all, or just nod along?
i just nod lol his brother works there too and supports Fenerbahce so they argue every match day
That must make the shop lively on derby day. A family rivalry over the counter is quite something.
its hilarious honestly customers pick sides
Ha, a neighbourhood sport all of its own.
the landlord mr haddad came round today to fix the window finally
About time. Was it the one that wouldn't shut properly?
yeah the bedroom one it was whistling all night
That's maddening. Hopefully it's quiet now.
oh i was wrong about tariq earlier its not salsa its bachata he corrected me when i said it lol he was offended
Ha, dancers take that distinction seriously. Easy mix-up for the rest of us though.
he said theyre completely different i cant tell
To an outsider they can look similar; the footwork is where the difference shows.
the party is getting louder omg
Ugh. If it's past the noise curfew, you could message the neighbours or the council line.
freya just got in shes been working late cause she just started at the cinema on the high street
That explains the late hours. Free films could be a nice perk.
she says she gets free popcorn which is better honestly
Fair, popcorn is a solid perk.
lol ok im gonna try sleep with a pillow over my head
Good luck, I hope the party winds down soon.
